text: You are provided with solutions S1, S2, S3, S4 and S5 which represent extracts from different
tissues of a plant, including the xylem.
You are required to identify which biological molecule may be present in each of the plant
Four of the solutions contain one type of biological molecule, which could be:
Each solution contains one type of biological molecule, but the same type of biological
molecule may be present in more than one of S1, S2, S3, S4 and S5.
For example, glucose may be present in S1 AND S2.
The solution from the xylem does not contain any of these biological molecules.
